تتمنطقون (form IIq)
# تَتَمَنْطَقُونَ (tatamanṭaqūna) /ta.ta.man.tˤa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# تُتَمَنْطَقُونَ (tutamanṭaqūna) /tu.ta.man.tˤa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
